items.title: 2 Industrials Stocks with Competitive Advantages and 1 We Question
items.summary: Whether you see them or not, industrials businesses play a crucial part in our daily activities. Still, their generally high capital requirements expose them to the ups and downs of economic cycles, and the industry’s six-month return of 8.1% has fallen short of the S&P 500’s 11.4% rise.
